# Seeds of Renaissance Design System

> The brand and design system for Seeds of Renaissance: feel, voice, colour, type, layout, woodcut graphics, photography, logo, components and whole-page examples, with the CSS to build from. Version 0.1. Every .md link below is raw markdown.

To build something: read BUILD.md first, open the guide for what you are making (website, social and Canva, YouTube, podcast, slides, print, diagrams, email), copy the closest example, use only the tokens and classes in system/, and check against the lists in BUILD.md and the guide. Topic pages hold the detail; you rarely need them for a first draft.

## Start

- [BUILD.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/BUILD.md): start here. Rules in one paragraph, which guide to use for what you are making, rules that apply everywhere, checklist.
- [examples.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/examples.md): every kind of thing we make, its guide, examples and status

## Topics

- [feel.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/feel.md): grounded hope, what we are not, registers, principles
- [voice.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/voice.md): how we sound, key lines, rewrites, calls to action (draft)
- [colour.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/colour.md): grounds, inks and the one accent, with roles and rules
- [type.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/type.md): the four faces, the scale, and why
- [layout.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/layout.md): grounds and rhythm, torn edges, grid and spacing
- [graphics.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/graphics.md): woodcut swallow, seal, seeds and clusters, and how to use them
- [photography.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/photography.md): what to choose and avoid (all current photos are placeholders)
- [logo.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/logo.md): versions and placement (provisional)
- [components.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/components.md): every component, when to use it, HTML to copy

## Guides by kind

- [website.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/website.md): web pages: page shell, section menu, checklist
- [social.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/social.md): social media and announcements in every shape, and the Canva kit (stub with brief)
- [youtube.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/youtube.md): YouTube thumbnails and channel art
- [podcast.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/podcast.md): podcast show art and episode covers (stub)
- [slides.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/slides.md): slide decks (brief)
- [print.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/print.md): papers as PDF and posters: covers, anatomy of a paper
- [publishing.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/publishing.md): how we build a paper, PDF and web: design, anatomy, editorial craft, pipeline
- [diagrams.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/diagrams.md): diagrams, figures and charts: type, drawing style, charts, the signature, how to build one as SVG (v0.1); examples at https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/examples/diagrams/index.html
- [email.md](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/email.md): the newsletter (stub)

## Code

- [system/tokens.css](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/system/tokens.css): every colour, face, size and space
- [system/components.src.css](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/system/components.src.css): components, readable source
- [system/components.css](https://sor-design-system-rufuspollock.flowershow.me/system/components.css): components, built (link this one)
